services.matcherHeading: Not sure where to start? Start with the problem.

matcher.problem: We answer the same enquiries all day
Leads go cold before anyone follows up
We copy details from one tool into another
We know AI could help, but not where
Our website doesn’t bring in enquiries

faq.q: Which service should I start with?
faq.a: Start with the task that costs you the most time or the most missed business. If that’s enquiries, an AI agent or AI automation usually comes first. If you’re not sure, a short consulting call will map it out.

faq.q: Can I combine more than one service?
faq.a: Yes, and many projects do. A website that captures enquiries, an automation that sorts them and an AI agent that replies can all be scoped as one project.

faq.q: Do I have to change the tools I already use?
faq.a: Usually not. We connect the CRM, inbox, forms, spreadsheets and WhatsApp you already use, as long as they allow connections.

faq.q: How is the price worked out?
faq.a: Every project is scoped and priced in writing before any work starts, based on what it needs to do. You know the cost, and what’s included, up front.

faq.q: Do you work with businesses outside India?
faq.a: Yes. We work remotely with businesses in India and abroad, by video call, email and WhatsApp.

about.heading: Practical AI for businesses that want to work smarter.
about.lead: Ostendic builds AI automations, AI agents and websites that take repetitive work off your team and turn more enquiries into customers.
body: Good businesses lose hours every week to work a computer could do: answering the same questions, chasing leads, copying details from one tool into another. We build automations and AI agents around how you already work, and websites that make it easy for customers to say yes.
We’re founder-led and small by design. You talk to the person building your system, every project is scoped and priced in writing, and you end up with something your team can actually run.
about.approachHeading: Four things we hold to on every project

approach.title: Start with the business problem
approach.text: Before we talk about tools, we want to know what’s slowing you down and what a good result looks like for you.

approach.title: Say what it costs before starting
approach.text: You get the scope and the price in writing before any work starts, including what isn’t included.

approach.title: Build what you can keep running
approach.text: We pick tools your team can live with after launch, and hand over everything you need to run them.

approach.title: Keep people in the loop
approach.text: Automation handles the routine steps. Anything that needs judgement stays with a person.

privacy: We collect only what you send through the enquiry form on this site: your name, email address, and, if you choose to give them, your phone number, business name, budget range, the service you’re interested in and your project description.
We use those details for one purpose: to reply to your enquiry and, if we work together, to scope and deliver the work. We don’t sell them, and we don’t add you to a marketing list.
Enquiries are stored in our database for as long as we reasonably need them for an ongoing or possible engagement. Ask us to delete yours and we will.
For anything about your data, email harsh@ostendic.com.
